headline: Review of FY2026 OPEB actuarial reports, $14,000 Mass Cultural Council grant, $24,476 FY27 MRST/Traffic Court grant, and retirement COLA increase.
summary: The agenda covers review of the FY2026 OPEB actuarial valuation reports and acceptance of two grants. It also includes a retirement cost-of-living adjustment and accounts with spending over their authorized amounts.
items: Review and discussion of the City's FY2026 OPEB Actuarial Valuation Reports (continued from October 22, 2026)
Acceptance of the Mass Cultural Council Grant in the amount of $14,000 (continued from October 22, 2026)
Acceptance of the FY27 MRST/Traffic Court grant in the amount of $24,476
Cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) increase, from the Executive Director of the Gloucester Contributory Retirement System Board
Accounts with expenditures that exceed their authorization, Auditor's Report, and other related business
location: 1st Floor Council Conference Room, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930

### AGENDA

**Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda**

1. Memorandum from the City Auditor requesting review and discussion of the City's FY2026 OPEB Actuarial Valuation Reports (cont. from October 22, 2026)

2. Memorandum from the Arts, Culture and Events Coordinator requesting acceptance of the Mass Cultural Council Grant in the amount of $14,000 (cont. from October 22, 2026)

3. Memorandum from the Interim Police Chief requesting acceptance of the FY27 MRST/Traffic Court grant in the amount of $24,476

4. Memorandum from the Executive Director of the Gloucester Contributory Retirement System Board regarding a cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) increase.

5. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding accounts having expenditures which exceed their authorization & Auditor's Report and other related business
